libraries.name: AI Agents & Tool Use
libraries.description: Agent architectures, tool use, computer interfaces, and reliable environment interaction.

papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.abstract: Introduces interleaved reasoning traces and environment actions so language models can plan, gather information, and recover from exceptions.

papers.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
papers.abstract: Shows how a language model can learn when and how to call external APIs using self-supervised tool-use examples.

papers.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
papers.abstract: Demonstrates that an agent-computer interface designed for language models materially improves repository navigation, editing, and testing.

papers.title: Cognitive Architectures for Language Agents
papers.abstract: Organizes language agents around modular memory, structured action spaces, and a generalized decision-making loop.

libraries.name: Reasoning & Test-Time Scaling
libraries.description: Process supervision, reasoning models, inference-time compute, and efficient deliberation.

papers.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Studies reinforcement learning recipes that elicit long-form reasoning behavior and distill it into smaller language models.

papers.title: s1: Simple test-time scaling
papers.abstract: Explores a compact reasoning dataset and budget forcing as a simple route to test-time scaling.

papers.title: Let's Verify Step by Step
papers.abstract: Compares outcome and process supervision, introducing step-level feedback data for training more reliable mathematical reasoning.

papers.title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking
papers.abstract: Trains language models to generate latent rationales before future text, extending self-taught reasoning beyond question answering.

libraries.name: RAG & Long Context
libraries.description: Retrieval-augmented generation, hierarchical indexing, adaptive retrieval, and long-context readers.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.abstract: Establishes a general retrieval-augmented generation recipe combining parametric models with an explicit dense knowledge index.

papers.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
papers.abstract: Adds learned retrieval and reflection decisions so a model can retrieve on demand and critique evidence and generations.

papers.title: RAPTOR: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
papers.abstract: Builds a hierarchy of clustered summaries to retrieve information at several abstraction levels across long documents.

papers.title: LongRAG: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Long-context LLMs
papers.abstract: Rebalances retrieval and reading by using larger retrieval units and long-context models instead of many short chunks.

libraries.name: Embodied AI & VLA
libraries.description: Vision-language-action models, generalist robot policies, and embodied reasoning in 3D environments.

papers.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
papers.abstract: Represents robot actions as tokens and co-fine-tunes on web-scale vision-language data and robot trajectories.

papers.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Presents an open 7B vision-language-action model trained on diverse robot demonstrations with efficient fine-tuning support.

papers.title: An Embodied Generalist Agent in 3D World
papers.abstract: Introduces LEO, a generalist multimodal agent for 3D perception, grounding, reasoning, navigation, and manipulation.

papers.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
papers.abstract: Trains a generalist transformer policy on a large cross-robot dataset and adapts it to new sensors, actions, and platforms.
